ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of low-intensity (black) to mid-to-high intensity (grey/white) pixels across the visible ventral plane.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central low-intensity black region extending to the trailing edges. Mid-lobe areas exhibit diffuse grey/white mottling. The right lobe mid-section contains a contiguous high-intensity white region with discrete low-intensity focal spots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximate 85-degree V-shaped median notch with a pixel depth relative to the vertical fluke axis of approximately 1:10.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous boundary with low-amplitude, low-frequency serrations; no major jagged interruptions except for those caused by distal tip anomalies.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the leading edges of both lobes, tapering to distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, irregular, high-contrast reddish-brown clusters (bio-fouling or lesions) attached to both distal tips of the fluke.
other_distinctive_markers: The symmetrical presence of dense, textured biological growth at both fluke tips which significantly modifies the expected tip geometry.
